visual: Deep lavender-blue flower panicles · olive-green leaves with purple undersides
soilWarning: Shelter from cold winds · avoid winter wet
prune: Prune in early spring; deadhead to encourage repeat flowering
cvs: trade name Flip Side; First Editions Series; cultivar code 'Bailtexone'; hybrid of Vitex trifolia 'Purpurea' × V. agnus-castus
hardinessNote: H5 inferred from reported USDA zone 7 tolerance
resilience: drought tolerant · heat tolerant · coastal tolerant
uses: specimen · shrub borders · wildlife gardens · informal hedging
uncertain: The supplied 'Vitex agnus-castus Flip Side' was reconciled to the hybrid cultivar marketed as Flip Side; RHS currently lists the trade name as Vitex Flip Side ('Bailtexone')
Some nursery sources retain Vitex agnus-castus in the botanical name, while breeder material identifies it as a cross involving V. trifolia 'Purpurea' and V. agnus-castus
Mature dimensions vary from approximately 1.5 m in UK retail descriptions to about 2.5–3 m in specialist sources
